word_sample.methodological_issue: The original probe sampled raw JMdict/KRDICT index forms rather than only the forms accepted as publishable headwords by the dictionary loader.

notes: Heuristic flags were treated as review signals rather than automatic failures.
The original word-page probe overcounted failures by treating alternate dictionary index rows as publishable headwords.
A reproducible canonical-source reaudit saved every sampled URL and found 150 of 150 published pages available.
The indexing review separately found that KRDICT's constant sequence value collapsed real Korean homonyms; that loader defect is covered by dedicated regression tests.
Rare cards with uncertain or unattested glosses were not rewritten speculatively.
The 頃 repair changes only the learner-facing gloss and mnemonic; the full Chinese and Japanese dictionary senses remain available on the page.
